name: @core/explain
summary: Explanatory simulations: algorithms, physics with animatable parameters, workflows.
guide:
Scenes: explain:sort {algorithm, n|values, words}, explain:pathfinding {algorithm, grid}, explain:physics {kind: pendulum|spring|projectile|orbit|particles|wave, settings}, explain:pipeline {steps, packets}.
Raw layer {"type":"sim", "kind":…}: every physics parameter can be keyframed in seconds, e.g. "gravity": [[0, 9.8], [3, 1.6]] (Earth → Moon), "temperature": [[0, 0.3], [2, 3]].
Readout words are English by default; translate with "words": {"comparisons": "comparaisons", "swaps": "échanges", "visited": "visitées", "path": "chemin", "found": "trouvé"}.
